beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps dense image information in a carrier while a compact DQ-CTM process updates windowed tokens through shared recurrent ticks.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The method separates dense image storage from the compact process that reasons over it. The encoder makes the low-resolution input usable as a feature field. Windowing turns that field into token groups without dropping spatial coverage. The DQ-CTM step reads and updates those tokens repeatedly, with parameters shared across ticks. The decoder turns the updated dense representation back into a super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR runs dense features through compact shared ticks
params.note: The recurrence stays inside the DQ-CTM thought stage.

beats.intent: The carrier equation says the encoder creates the dense feature field first, then window partitioning maps that field into tokens while keeping every token.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The carrier starts as a dense feature field before the compact process touches it. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into that field. The window partition consumes the feature field and preserves the token set for the thought process.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded before it is windowed

window partition over the dense feature field

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the comparison; at 1.129 million parameters it is second largest among the five listed methods.
beats.claim: Competitive with CNN baselines; behind recent lightweight transformers.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison does not support calling DQ-CTM-SR cheap. CATANet is the smallest model in the reported set. RFDN and IMDN remain below one million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR has 1.129 million parameters, making it the second largest of the five. CARN is the only listed method with a larger parameter count.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is the second largest model listed
